mapper.select: SELECT saving_id AS savingId, product_type AS productType, is_active AS isActive, fin_prdt_cd AS finPrdtCd, kor_co_nm AS korCoNm, product_name AS productName, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm AS saveTrm, basic_rate AS basicRate, max_rate AS maxRate, is_tax_exempt AS isTaxExempt, gov_match_rate AS govMatchRate FROM ( SELECT saving_id, product_type, is_active, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, product_name, min_limit, max_limit, save_trm, basic_rate, max_rate, is_tax_exempt, gov_match_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fin_prdt_cd ORDER BY max_rate DESC, save_trm DESC ) AS rn FROM saving_product WHERE product_type = #{productType} AND is_active = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N' ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY max_rate DESC, product_name

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm_note AS saveTrmNote, has_calculator AS hasCalculator, max_rate AS maxRate, normal_match_rate AS normalMatchRate, prefer_match_rate AS preferMatchRate FROM policy_product WHERE policy_status = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY max_rate DESC, policy_name
